system.description: Horse ears allow hearing sounds and conversations within the listed range. Isolating a particular sound requires a base 10 situation test: +5 in the wilderness, +0 in a village, -5 in a busy city; the GM adjusts for ambient noise.
system.summary: The Bruid hears all noises and conversations within range.
